proves: Formulas referencing another workbook ([1]Sheet1!A1) must set the .externalLink cell flag and must NEVER be resolved or fetched.
valuesVerifiedBy: hand-authored raw OOXML (the bytes ARE the expectation)
mustNotHappen: any filesystem or network read of the externalLinkPath target
notes: The link target is a file:/// URL that does not exist. If a test observes an open() on it, the reader is broken (PLAN.md 7.3).
